criteria.label: Projection remains world-anchored
criteria.failure: Texture, wetness, or decal features slide across the terrain while the camera moves.

criteria.label: No temporal flicker or unstable shimmer
criteria.failure: A stationary terrain feature changes discontinuously between adjacent motion frames.

criteria.label: Triplanar transitions remain coherent
criteria.failure: Axis transitions expose a hard seam, inversion, or disproportionate stretching.

criteria.label: Camera detail fade is continuous
criteria.failure: Normal detail pops, reverses, or changes abruptly between the near and far endpoints.

criteria.label: Normal response remains coherent
criteria.failure: Mapped normals invert, form an axis-dependent lighting discontinuity, or detach from geometry.

criteria.label: Slope, height, wetness, and decal masks remain attached
criteria.failure: A diagnostic mask swims, flickers, or appears on a surface that violates its declared rule.

criteria.label: Shading introduces no visible surface discontinuity
criteria.failure: The lit or diagnostic view exposes a shading crack not present in the qualified geometry evidence.

criteria.label: Cast shadow remains attached to the terrain
criteria.failure: A cast-shadow boundary visibly slides, pops, or changes topology over a fixed world-space surface during camera motion.

explicitly_out_of_scope: shadow silhouette smoothness across terrain resolutions (TQP-25)
